name: Anittel Communications
summary: Hosting/telecoms subsidiary of the Anittel Group (ex-AK Communications (Australia) / Hostech Communications); folded into the Anittel Group acquired by BigAir ~2014; parent ANITTEL PTY LTD (ACN 123 808 677) remains registered.

events.details: AK Communications (Australia) Pty Ltd; renamed Hostech Communications, then Anittel Communications.
Folded into the Anittel Group acquired by BigAir (announced late 2013, completed 2014).
source: BigAir Group acquisition of Anittel Group Limited (ASX:AYG), 2013-2014

events.details: ABN 81123808677 (ANITTEL PTY LTD, ACN 123 808 677) is the parent Anittel Pty Ltd, registered 6 Feb 2007 and still active per ABR; it is cited here for the group lineage, not as the distinct legal vehicle of the communications subsidiary (whose own ACN is not established).
